scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:web && npm run test:server
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/web && npm run build -w packages/desktop
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w packages/web && npm run build -w packages/desktop
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w packages/web && npm run package -w packages/desktop
scripts.build:android: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w packages/web && npm run cap:sync -w packages/web
scripts.build:apk: npm run build:android && powershell -Command "$env:JAVA_HOME = 'C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr'; cd packages/web/android; .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug; Copy-Item app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../../../release/android/Tactical-Arena-FC-debug.apk -Force"
scripts.import:content: npm run build:shared && npm run import:content -w packages/server
